description: Replace the n512/n1024 Householder-tridiagonal route with fixed-sweep block-cyclic Jacobi: partition A into 32- or 64-column blocks, solve paired principal tiles device-side, apply round-robin two-sided rotations to A and accumulate Q through native sm_100a tcgen05/TMEM/TMA, then sort and certify. Exploit the checker tolerance for device-side convergence and selective exact fallback; preserve serial evaluation and other sizes, with no WMMA production path.

Python/cuBLAS block-cyclic Jacobi prototype with 32-column blocks and two sweeps; validation reached n512 then failed before numerical checking because in-place principal-tile symmetrization aliases its transpose

Two-sweep 32-column block-cyclic Jacobi proof using batched 64x64 exact tile solves and cuBLAS rotation application; 39/39 pass, but launch-heavy Python gather/scatter route measures 96417.671 us aggregate with n512 625-691 ms and n1024 387-391 ms

Replaced Python/cuSolver block loop with native sm100a 64x64 shared-memory cyclic Jacobi and cta_group::2 tcgen05/TMEM high+low TF32 A/Q rotations, transposing A on write; 39/39 pass but certificate falls back, aggregate 104771.175 us, n512 746-813 ms, n1024 410-415 ms

Bypassed internal certificate to measure raw two-global-sweep native Jacobi output; diagonal cases pass but all dense n512/n1024 cases fail with checker-scaled eigen residuals roughly 1e4-7e4, proving exact fallback was masking incomplete global convergence

Raw four-global-sweep native result remains invalid and worsens to roughly 1.3e4-8.9e4 scaled eigen residual; source audit identifies the rotation pass computed only R^T A via transposed A R and omitted the second R factor required for R^T A R

Corrected native similarity update to two tcgen05 passes per round, C=A*R then Anew=(C^T*R)^T, while Q updates once; 39/39 pass, aggregate 110857.136 us, n512 800-867 ms and n1024 453-458 ms with most dense matrices still selectively exact-fallback

Raw corrected two-global-sweep result: diagonal and clustered n1024 test pass, but other dense cases fail at roughly 2.5e3-1.6e4 checker-scaled eigen residual, a 4-10x reduction versus the incomplete one-sided transform

Raw corrected four-global-sweep result passes diagonal, rowscale n512 and clustered n1024 but remaining dense cases fail at roughly 700-9600 checker-scaled eigen residual; two added sweeps reduce typical residual another 3-6x

Raw corrected six-global-sweep result passes dense baseline, band/rowscale and clustered n1024; remaining cases fail mostly at 368-915 scaled residual, with clustered/mixed n512 up to 2020, showing continued convergence above a 200 gate

Raw two-global-sweep result with ten rather than five local 64x64 cyclic sweeps remains roughly 2.9e3-1.7e4 scaled residual, indistinguishable from five local sweeps; local pivot convergence is not limiting the two-sweep route

Generalized native tcgen05 rotation pipeline to 16-column blocks and replaced 64x64 CTA pivots with per-round CUDA 13.3 cusolverDnXsyevBatched n32 pivots; one global sweep, 39/39 pass with selective fallback, aggregate 94029.613 us, n512 571-638 ms, n1024 393-397 ms

Two-global-sweep bracket for 16-column/cusolver n32 pivots; 39/39 pass with broad certificate and selective fallback, aggregate 135404.832 us, n512 996-1062 ms and n1024 667-672 ms versus one-sweep 94029.613 us

Replaced profiled cusolver n32 pivot bottleneck with existing fused device Householder/inverse-iteration n32 kernel after each gather; one global sweep, 39/39 pass with selective fallback, aggregate improves 94029.613 to 91717.544 us, n512 554-621 ms and n1024 380-384 ms

Made each two-SM tcgen05/TMEM A/Q rotation cluster persistent across all pair tiles in a round, retaining TMEM allocation and removing pair-factor cluster fanout; 39/39 pass, aggregate improves 91717.544 to 90397.058 us, n512 529-596 ms, n1024 381-385 ms

64x64 scaffold bracket with one outer sweep and one local cyclic sweep, using persistent tcgen05/TMEM rotations and broad selective fallback; 39/39 pass, aggregate improves to 63228.713 us, n512 301-368 ms and n1024 229-233 ms

Raw fastest one-outer/one-local-sweep n64 output audit: only diagonal and clustered n1024 pass; dense n512/n1024 fail at roughly 4.6e3-2.5e4 checker-scaled eigen residual versus the 200 eigen gate, so broad fallback is required

Terminal passing commit 7bf4465e3 implements one outer sweep of 32-column paired 64x64 Jacobi pivots with one local cyclic sweep and persistent sm_100a cta_group::2 tcgen05/TMEM high+low rotations; 39/39 validation, 63228.713 us aggregate (n512 301-368 ms, n1024 229-233 ms). Profile attributes n512 batch640 cost to 102.4 ms rotation application, 50.3 ms pivots, then about 176 ms exact fallback. Raw fastest output is 4.6e3-2.5e4 scaled residual versus gate 200; accurate five-local-sweep outer counts reduced residual from 2.5e3-1.6e4 at two sweeps to 700-9600 at four and 368-2020 at six, while multiplying native cost. Also measured Python/cuSolver prototype 96417.671 us, corrected native five-local path 110857.136 us, n32 cuSolver one/two sweeps 94029.613/135404.832 us, fused n32 91717.544 us, and persistent n32 90397.058 us. A future distinct brief would need fuse both sides of each block-tile similarity update while retaining the intermediate in TMEM and defer or tree-compose Q, rather than replay global A/Q traffic per round; the current measured global formulation remains above the 22775.718 us parent.
